import array
n, m = map(int, input().split())
a = array.array('L')
a.extend(map(int, input().split()))
first_half, second_half = array.array('L'), array.array('L')
mid = n // 2

def generate_first(i, total=0):
    if i == mid:
        first_half.append(total)
    else:

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int mid = n / 2;
    std::vector<unsigned long> first_half, second_half;

    // Generate first half sums
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_first = [&](int i, unsigned long total) {
        if (i == mid) {
            first_half.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_first(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_first(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    // Generate second half sums
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_second = [&](int i, unsigned long total) {
        if (i == n) {
            second_half.push_back(total);
        } else {
            generate_second(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            generate_second(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    generate_first(0, 0);
    generate_second(mid, 0);

    unsigned long best_sum = 0;
    std::vector<unsigned long> sorted_first = first_half;
    std::sort(sorted_first.begin(), sorted_first.end());
    auto last = std::unique(sorted_first.begin(), sorted_first.end());
    sorted_first.erase(last, sorted_first.end());

    for (auto val : second_half) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(sorted_first.begin(), sorted_first.end(), m - val);
        if (it != sorted_first.begin()) {
            --it;
            unsigned long candidate = *it + val;
            if (candidate > best_sum) {
                best_sum = candidate;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << best_sum << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
